sloka: शतं क्रतूनामाहृत्य देवराट् त्रिदिवङ्गत: ।तपांस्युग्राणि चास्थाय दिवं याता महर्षय: ॥ २.१०९.२९॥
transliteration: śataṁ kratūnāmāhṛtya devarāṭ tridivaṅgata: ।tapāṁsyugrāṇi cāsthāya divaṁ yātā maharṣaya: ॥ 2.109.29॥

translations.english: After performing a hundred sacrifices, king of the gods (Indra) obtained (dominion over) heaven. Great sages attained heaven after resorting to intense mortifications.
